verdict.rationale: Grok Build is a coding agent, so an issue-to-PR workflow is a fair question for this product type. The evidence never documents taking a tracked issue and producing a pull request. Adding a Linear MCP server, plan mode, todo lists and worktrees are adjacent building blocks, not the end-to-end capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end
